previous.changeLog:
- Updated Contour icons ASMA and added a variant with armor
- Updated Battle Equipment (fixed issue with losing slot components when active state was changed (in case of stereoscope and camoflauge net)
- Updated HangMan Garage Manager 2.74 (- fixed the camera circling the usual vehicle spot instead of the vehicle when the vehicle was moved on one of the game's garages, such as V4; added the game's garage camera animations to garages made from battle maps: the camera slowly circles the vehicle when idle and moves slightly with the mouse cursor, following the game setting)
- Updated Armor Inspector Wotinspector

current.changeLog:
- Updated Updated Mod Menu 2.1.01 (ready for WoT 2.4.1.0; your settings are kept when a mod adds new options; fixed text under pictures in tooltips and settings not being saved with some mods)
- Updated Effect Control 1.0.4
- Updated Scheduled Personal Reserves 2.1.0 (added a way to keep schedulings active through multiple sessions and different accounts)
- Updated Classic Tank Carousel 1.0.20 (fixed vehicle card statistics not refreshing after a battle)
- Updated Expected Vehicle Values 2.05.001 (fixed the garage panel disappearing after its first drag on a fresh install; the panel can no longer be dragged off the top or bottom of the screen)
- Added Depth of Field (by Aslain) (blurs the background like a camera lens, for screenshots and videos: in the garage and in replays, in battles only if you switch it on; focus on your vehicle, at a fixed distance or on the screen center, set separately for the arcade, sniper and artillery views; settings panel on CTRL+F9)
